name: ashen-vow
description: An original top-down pixel action RPG prototype. No build step, no dependencies.

scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.android:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npx tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npx tauri build
